info.title: Storefront API
info.description: The Lunar storefront API. Generated from the resource registry; add-on fields and endpoints appear automatically.

tags.name: products
tags.description: Sellable products with their lowest price for the request. Only published products scheduled into the request channel and visible to its customer groups are served.

tags.name: variants
tags.description: A sellable variant of a product with its stock and price for the request.

tags.name: product-option-values
tags.description: A value of a product option, such as Red for Colour, as carried by a variant.

tags.name: brands
tags.description: Brands group products under a manufacturer or label. Only active brands are served.

tags.name: collections
tags.description: Nested groupings of products, such as categories. Only collections visible in the request channel and customer groups are served.

tags.name: collection-groups
tags.description: Named sets of collections, such as a main menu or a seasonal campaign.

tags.name: urls
tags.description: A slug a product, collection or brand is reachable at, per language.

tags.name: carts
tags.description: The calculated cart for the request. Carts are addressed by the signed X-Lunar-Cart token, not by id.

tags.name: cart-lines
tags.description: A purchasable and quantity on a cart, with its calculated totals. Lines are embedded in carts and have no endpoints of their own.

tags.name: customers
tags.description: The customer record behind an authenticated storefront user.

parameters.name: filter

id.description: Match by public id. Operators: eq, ne, in, not_in.

sku.description: Products with a variant matching this SKU. Operators: eq, in, like.

price.description: Compare the single-unit base price in minor units of the request currency. Operators: eq, gt, gte, lt, lte.

parameters.description: Filters, for example `filter[handle]=acme` or `filter[price][gte]=1000`. `filter[name]=value` is shorthand for the `eq` operator.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Sellable products with their lowest price for the request. Only published products scheduled into the request channel and visible to its customer groups are served.

id.description: The public id of the product.

name.description: The product name in the request locale.

description.description: The long description in the request locale.

short_description.description: The short description in the request locale.

slug.description: The slug of the default URL, or null when the product has none.

brand_id.description: Public id of the brand, or null.

attributes.description: Attribute values keyed by handle, translated into the request locale.

price.description: The lowest single-unit variant price for the request currency and customer groups, or null when no variant is priced.

updated_at.description: When the product was last updated.

brand.description: The brand, null when the product has none. Present when included.

variants.description: Every variant of the product. Present when included.

collections.description: Collections the product is in that are visible to the request. Present when included.

urls.description: Every URL of the product. Present when included.

Variant.title: Variant
Variant.description: A sellable variant of a product with its stock and price for the request.

id.description: The public id of the variant.

min_quantity.description: Smallest quantity that can be added to a cart.

selling_policy.description: How the variant sells relative to its stock.

purchasable.description: Whether the variant can be added to a cart right now.

price.description: The single-unit price for the request currency and customer groups, or null when unpriced.

product.description: The parent product. Present when included.

values.description: The option values that distinguish this variant. Present when included.

ProductOptionValue.title: Product option value
ProductOptionValue.description: A value of a product option, such as Red for Colour, as carried by a variant.

id.description: The public id of the product option value.

name.description: The value name in the request locale, such as Red.

option.description: The option name in the request locale, such as Colour.

option_id.description: Public id of the option the value belongs to.

Brand.title: Brand
Brand.description: Brands group products under a manufacturer or label. Only active brands are served.

id.description: The public id of the brand.

handle.description: The unique handle, used by the handle filter.

description.description: The long description in the request locale.

short_description.description: The short description in the request locale.

slug.description: The slug of the default URL, or null when the brand has none.

attributes.description: Attribute values keyed by handle, translated into the request locale.

updated_at.description: When the brand was last updated.

products.description: Products of the brand visible to the request. Present when included.

urls.description: Every URL of the brand. Present when included.

Collection.title: Collection
Collection.description: Nested groupings of products, such as categories. Only collections visible in the request channel and customer groups are served.

id.description: The public id of the collection.

name.description: The collection name in the request locale.

handle.description: The unique handle, used by the handle filter.

description.description: The long description in the request locale.

short_description.description: The short description in the request locale.

slug.description: The slug of the default URL, or null when the collection has none.

parent_id.description: Public id of the parent collection; null for a root collection.

group_id.description: Public id of the collection group.

attributes.description: Attribute values keyed by handle, translated into the request locale.

group.description: The group the collection belongs to. Present when included.

parent.description: The parent collection, null for a root. Present when included.

children.description: Child collections visible to the request. Present when included.

products.description: Products in the collection visible to the request. Present when included.

urls.description: Every URL of the collection. Present when included.

CollectionGroup.description: Named sets of collections, such as a main menu or a seasonal campaign.

id.description: The public id of the collection group.

handle.description: The unique handle, used by the handle filter.

updated_at.description: When the group was last updated.

collections.description: Collections in the group visible to the request. Present when included.

Url.title: Url
Url.description: A slug a product, collection or brand is reachable at, per language.

id.description: The public id of the url.

default.description: Whether this is the canonical URL for its language.

language.description: Language code the URL belongs to.

Cart.title: Cart
Cart.description: The calculated cart for the request. Carts are addressed by the signed X-Lunar-Cart token, not by id.

id.description: The public id of the cart.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the cart currency.

channel.description: Handle of the channel the cart belongs to.

coupon_code.description: The coupon code applied to the cart, if any.

sub_total.description: Sum of line sub totals, before discounts and tax.

updated_at.description: When the cart was last changed.

CartLine.title: Cart line
CartLine.description: A purchasable and quantity on a cart, with its calculated totals. Lines are embedded in carts and have no endpoints of their own.

id.description: The public id of the cart line.

quantity.description: Units of the purchasable on the line.

purchasable_type.description: The purchasable morph alias, for example product_variant.

identifier.description: The purchasable identifier, such as the variant SKU.

description.description: The purchasable description, such as the product name.

unit_price.description: Price of one unit before discounts.

sub_total.description: Unit price times quantity, before discounts and tax.

total.description: Line total after discounts and tax.

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata attached when the line was added.

Customer.title: Customer

account_ref.description: The account reference in an external system.

updated_at.description: When the customer record was last updated.

Money.description: A monetary amount in minor units with its currency, so arithmetic never needs to know the decimal places.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

XLunarChannel.name: X-Lunar-Channel

XLunarCart.name: X-Lunar-Cart
XLunarCart.description: The signed cart token a previous response returned on X-Lunar-Cart. An invalid or expired token is rejected with 401, a token for a cart that no longer exists with 404.
